$Comment: The Burning Grave Candle again, priced in Life Essence and Fire Essence with no Sweets: a second way to pay for the Headless Horseman's hard ride, set high so the Sweets offers stay the usual way. Life Essence is an item-backed wallet this pack ships (Currencies/MMOSkillTree/Life_Essence.json), taken as Ingredient_Life_Essence from the bag; Fire Essence is an item price (Cost.Items, Ingredient_Fire_Essence from the bag, storage or hotbar), so the offer works on every server. Requires is the Trusted Sweets offer's own lock: it opens once Old Jack counts the player Trusted (Honored with Old Jack's Favor), and a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line. Keep the lock the same as Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle.json's and Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle_Trade.json's (the trade shares SortOrder 8 and follows this offer by id). SortOrder 8 sits it straight after the two Sweets offers (SortOrder 7) on the lanterns shelf. No purchase limit and no rotation. Cost is the price: raise or lower the Life Essence and the Fire Essence Count. Named by the item's own keys.
